gamefaqs.section: PlayStation PS3 Virtual Memory Card Save (ZIP) (Europe)

format: zip of 2 PS3 export(s) (.PSV): '\0VSP' header (signature, save name at 0x64), the save's blocks from 0x84 (8324 bytes); together they hold 2 save(s), 2 for this game (BASCES-02159S02-S01, BASCES-02159S02-S02)
